observations: Photo 0: White and grey baby wardrobe with double doors open, showing interior shelves and drawers. One drawer is open, revealing baby wipes. Interior contains various baby items including bottles, boxes, and a pink sippy cup. The wardrobe has black handles and decorative decals on the front.

Photo 1: Same wardrobe closed, showing front view. Left door has green leaf decals, right door has a deer and floral design with text 'Leisure time'. The drawers alternate white and grey with black handles and small decals.

Photo 2: Same as photo 0, slightly different angle, showing the same open doors and interior contents. The wardrobe appears to be made of plastic or particle board, not wood. No visible brand or model name on any surface.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI PETER OLA'.

identity.kind: baby wardrobe with double doors and eight drawers

claims.evidence: No visual evidence of age or usage history. The condition appears clean, but wear and tear cannot be assessed from photos alone.
Photo 0, 1, and 2 clearly show two doors on the top section of the wardrobe.
Photo 0 and 2 show four drawers on the bottom half; photo 1 shows the full front with four drawers visible. The arrangement is two columns of four drawers, totaling eight.
Photos show no visible stains, dust, or damage. The interior is organized and the exterior is free of obvious dirt or grime.

risks.risk: Material quality and durability (plastic or particle board may be flimsy or prone to damage)
risks.proof: Close-up shot of the material texture, edge construction, and drawer slides to assess build quality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as low-quality plastic/particle board, which reduces value

risks.risk: Structural integrity (doors may not close properly, drawers may stick or fall out)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing doors closing smoothly and drawers being opened and closed without resistance or wobbling.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or poorly assembled

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear (scratches, dents, or internal damage not visible in photos)
risks.proof: Photo of all sides, including back and bottom, and close-ups of corners and edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, reducing value

risks.risk: Missing parts (e.g., missing drawer handles, hinges, or internal components)
risks.proof: Photo showing all handles, hinges, and internal parts (like hanging rod) in place and functional.

proof_requests: Close-up of the material and construction quality (edges, corners, drawer slides).
Video or photo of doors closing and drawers opening/closing smoothly.
Photo of all sides, including back and bottom, to check for damage or missing parts.
Photo of the hanging rod and any internal shelves to confirm they are intact.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a baby wardrobe with double doors and eight drawers. The seller's claims about doors, drawers, and cleanliness are supported by the photos. While the age and material quality are unverifiable, the item can be priced at its worst-case condition (low-quality plastic, possibly unstable) based on visible evidence. Hidden risks are noted and will affect pricing, but a price is still possible.
